name: Diana E. Miranda-Dzib
office: Baldwin Park Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Diana E. Miranda-Dzib is a member of the Baldwin Park Unified School District Board of Education. She was first appointed as a trustee in 2017. She has served as board president. She is the coordinator of high school programs at Mt. San Antonio College.

sentences.text: Diana E. Miranda-Dzib is a member of the Baldwin Park Unified School District Board of Education.
She was first appointed as a trustee in 2017.
She has served as board president.
She is the coordinator of high school programs at Mt. San Antonio College.

items.text: While she was board president, the district won a 2023 Golden Bell Award for a mental health screening program that connected nearly 2,000 students to resources. The district also launched a mentorship partnership with Big Brothers Big Sisters while she was board president.
